Hi Michael,

Are you available for a quick 20-30 minute demo while we're both at KubeCon next week? I'll be on-site and can do either:
- Monday, Nov 8 between 10:00-14:00 PST
- Tuesday, Nov 9 morning (PST)

If you'd prefer in-person, I can meet at Booth 3A or we can do a virtual call — whichever works best for you. I'm including Rafael (sales) to help lock the calendar.

Quick note on timezones: the times above are PST (conference local time). If you're remote or traveling, tell me your timezone and I'll convert.

Thanks,

Subject: Re: Quick demo while we're both at KubeCon?

Marissa —

Thanks for the note. I'm actually traveling from London and currently in transit; local time here is GMT. Just to confirm: when you say 10:00 PST on Nov 8, that would be 18:00 GMT, right? I'm also planning to be on-site, but the hotel front desk and the conference app are showing slight different event-local times and I don't want to miss you.

I can do the 18:00 GMT / 10:00 PST slot, or if that's awkward for Redwood folks we could push to 19:00 GMT (11:00 PST). If we're meeting in-person, I'm happy to meet at Booth 3A or grab a quick room in the west lobby.

Also, my flight lands late evening Nov 8 — if we schedule for Nov 9 morning PST that might be safer.

—Michael
Michael Zhou

mzhou@acme.io | +44 20 7946 09xx

Thanks for the heads up, Michael — great question.

Confirming conversions: 10:00 PST = 18:00 GMT, and 11:00 PST = 19:00 GMT. The times I suggested were in PST (conference local time). Sorry for the ambiguity — that'll be on me to call out explicitly next time.

Given your flight landing late evening Nov 8, Nov 9 morning (PST) is probably the least risky. Would you be available Nov 9 at 09:30 PST (which is 17:30 GMT)? If you prefer in-person, let's plan for Booth 3A (we've got a power outlet and a small table).

I'll leave the invite details to Rafael — Rafael, can you send a calendar invite for Nov 9 09:30 PST / 17:30 GMT and include a short video link and booth location? I'll attach the demo agenda here.

Thanks — Marissa
